description: Loader conformance cases for kuhul.type-manifest.float.v1. Proves the four rejection conditions the manifest declares: out-of-range value, nonfinite float, wrong precision type, and unauthorized phase binding.
authority_note: ADMITTED means the value satisfies declared range, precision, and phase contracts. REJECTED means the loader must refuse with the stated reason. Neither outcome authorizes execution — XCFE admission is required separately.

loader_levels.ROUTING_ONLY: recognizes FLOAT:, @float, and other key-grammar aliases; ignores variants/bindings/operators
loader_levels.TYPED_BINDINGS: validates precision, numeric ranges, phase affinity, and operator signatures

cases.description: hub_cost = 0.166, float32, Yax — the formula value from pi_triangle_hub_costs
entropy_norm = 0.5, float32, Ch'en — mid-range levity signal
hub_cost = 0.0, float32, Yax — lower boundary of [0, 1] is inclusive
routing_weight = 1.5 exceeds [0, 1] — cannot be a valid routing probability
hub_cost = NaN — nonfinite values must produce status=1 in pi_triangle_hub_costs, never advance to Sek
hub_cost declared as float16 — float32 is required for accumulation precision; float16 reduces dynamic range
hub_cost presented at Xul — hub_cost is a Yax signal; advancing it to Xul without Ch'en verification bypasses ENTROPY_BOUNDS
